comments: Scanluma is a hosted monitoring service: users add their website and it is scanned automatically on a schedule. Scans cover public pages only. Free plan: homepage, weekly. Pro plan: homepage plus up to 10 subpages, weekly or daily, with mobile viewport scans.
features: Scanluma monitors your website for accessibility issues against WCAG 2.1 and 2.2 (Levels A and AA). Your site is scanned automatically every week or day. Each issue gets a plain-language explanation, a severity and the exact HTML element where it occurs, and your score is tracked over time. Free plan: homepage, weekly. Paid plans add subpages.
title: Scanluma
